title: Trakai Island Castle
visualBrief: Restored Trakai compound with open trapezoidal forecourt,three cone-roof corner towers,arched entry tower,western casemate and separate open-court ducal palace with a tall gabled donjon,short wooden bridge and stone precinct.

nativeAxes.longitudinal: +Z southwest toward forecourt and approach;palace side wings lie along Z

identityFeatures: Three faceted red-tile cone towers and square arched entrance
Open trapezoidal forecourt with long western casemate
Separate U-shaped palace,tall gabled donjon and connecting bridge

reconstruction.basis: Inspected reference pictures and standard viewer PMTiles.

geographicProposal.groundContactBasis: The inspected aerial picture confirms the separate palace/gabled donjon, open trapezoidal forecourt, three cone-capped corners, entrance tower and long casemate. Standard viewer PMTiles and the retained palace/courtyard outline establish approximate island location and forecourt approach sign. The mapped relation covers the palace only; whole-compound alignment remains an exterior estimate. A reconstructed1.3m working court clears the coarse island ground and bounded foundations extend beneath samples; short connecting bridge retained at its inferred level. Anchor 24.934056788,54.652709433; heading -1.112277445339; standard PMTiles datum 145.11330053210258m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground.

limitations: Approximate current exterior from inspected picture and standard viewer PMTiles; no bespoke survey or exact thresholds.
Original detailed architectural master/recipe preserved; derivative fits working courts and bounded foundation bottoms.
Palace/gabled donjon, three red cone roofs, entry passage, open forecourt, casemate, timber gallery and short connecting bridge retain identity. Fine openings and roof/bridge levels reconstructed.
Mapped relation is palace only; forecourt placement is approximate and footprint replacement remains off.
Lake/island terrain, long public shore bridge, trees, boats, excavation overlays, temporary structures and interiors excluded.
Four common material graphs and local opaque glass; zero embedded images. Physical-device timing pending.
importReason: Retain Trakai tower/forecourt/palace hierarchy,open courts,real gate voids and short connecting bridge in compact shared-material LODs.
